no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application as there were no issues that needed input from external experts.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA213036 (artesunate for injection). The FDA Multidiscipline Review states plainly that no AdComm was held because there were no issues requiring input from external experts. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
